gling bzhi spyi mdos kyi las 'grigs ni/dang po sngon 'gro'i bcas rnams grub nas/skyabs sems nas gzung*/yi dam gzhung ltar tshogs skong yan tshar nas/gli

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gling bzhi spyi mdos kyi las 'grigs ni/1$0000300

dang po sngon 'gro'i bcas rnams grub nas/ skyabs sems nas gzung*/ yi dam gzhung ltar tshogs skong yan tshar nas/ gling bzhi'i 'don 'grigs ni/ bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka: sogs nas/ srid pa'i mdos kyi gzu dpang mdzod: yan/ srid pa khod snyom nas/ kyai: rang bzhin rnam dag 'phrul gyi mdos: ces sogs nas/ tshim ni so so'i dbang po tshim: yan/ sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ gling bzhi nas/ gzi byin bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste: ces sogs nas/ glud bdag ni glud longs shig: yan/ khod snyom nas/ kyai: srid pa rlung la rten bcas pa'i: ces sogs nas/ mtshan ma med pa'i don la gnas par gyis: yan/ gling bzhi nas/ kyai: cho ga 'di la brten nas ni: ces sogs nas/ 'di la yon tan brjod mi langs: yan/ khod snyom nas/ rang bzhin mdos kyi nus pa dang: ces sogs nas/ bgegs kyis rgyu bar mi skabs so: yan/ chad mdo brtan skyong gzhung ltar sogs/ phyir lam gcad pa ni/ kyai: gnas 'di sngags pas byin brlabs nas: ces sogs nas/ de phyir bgegs tshogs mtshams chod cig: 'dre las rgyal nas lha ngo bstod pa ni/ kyai: sngags kyi bden pa chen po yis: ces sogs nas/ da ni bar chad bdud las rgyal: yan/ tshe 'gugs pa ni/ kyai: da ni bdud las rgyal ba'i mthus: zhes sogs nas/ sbyin bdag dpal dang tshe g.yang khug: ces bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam yi dam gzhung ltar brjod/ mdos gnyis kyi bca' thabs gling bzhi'i mgo yi yig chung ltar ro// gzhan yang sku glud/ byad thag /dmu thag /'brang rgyas/ shwa dkar nag /glang chen/ rnga mong khal bkal/ srin mo za lam/ glud snod sgye'u/ shang shang te'u/ rtsa nag /spom nag khram shing*/ spyi bo'i rdo leb/ stag pa'i gnya' shing la sogs pa gzhan mkho'i bcas rnams mdos gzhung nas ji ltar gsungs bzhin tshogs par gsag go /gzhan 'dir 'don bya bsham bkod rnams bla ma'i zhal la zhu zhing mthar chags bya'o// ces pa 'di ni kaḥthog rdo rje'i gdan du dbon po o rgyan rnam grol gyi zhal rgyun ltar bla ma sbyin pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o/// /
